title: TFHE: Fast Fully Homomorphic Encryption Over the Torus

extraction_issues.quote: TFHE: Fast Fully Homomorphic Encryption over the Torus $ ^{\star} $
extraction_issues.reason: 标题末尾的星号上标被 OCR 抽取为 LaTeX 片段 $ ^{\star} $，属于格式噪声，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: We denote by $ \mathbb{Z}{N}[X] $ the ring of polynomials $ \mathbb{Z}[X]/(X^{N}+1). $ $ \mathbb{T}{N}[X] $ denotes $ \mathbb{R}[X]/(X^{N}+1) $ mod 1 and $ \mathbb{B}{N}[X] $ denotes the polynomials in $ \mathbb{Z}{N}[X] $ with binary coefficients.
extraction_issues.reason: 下标 N 在 $\mathbb{Z}_N[X]$、$\mathbb{T}_N[X]$、$\mathbb{B}_N[X]$ 中被 OCR 抽取为普通字符 N 而非下标，导致符号显示为 $\mathbb{Z}{N}[X]$ 等，影响公式可读性。

extraction_issues.quote: For all closed (continuous or discrete) additive subgroup $ M\subseteq \mathbb{R}^{k},\rho_{\sigma ,\mathbf{c}}(M) $ is finite, and defines a (restricted) Gaussian Distribution $ \mathcal{D}{M,\sigma ,\mathbf{c}} $ of standard deviation $ \sigma $ and center $ \mathbf{c} $ over M, with the density function $ \mathcal{D}{M,\sigma ,\mathbf{c}}(\mathbf{x})= \rho_{\sigma ,\mathbf{c}}(\mathbf{x}) / \rho_{\sigma ,\mathbf{c}}(M). $
extraction_issues.reason: 分布符号 $\mathcal{D}_{M,\sigma,\mathbf{c}}$ 的下标在 OCR 中丢失，显示为 $\mathcal{D}{M,\sigma ,\mathbf{c}}$，影响公式准确性。

extraction_issues.quote: The error distribution $ \xi $ is $ (0,\mathcal{D}{\mathbb{T}{N}[X],\alpha}} $ where $ \mathcal{D}{\mathbb{T}{N}[X],\alpha} $ is the modular Gaussian distribution
extraction_issues.reason: 误差分布表达式 $\xi$ 为 $(0,\mathcal{D}_{\mathbb{T}_N[X],\alpha})$ 的括号与下标在 OCR 中错乱，出现多余花括号，影响公式完整性。

extraction_issues.quote: Since $ \bar{a}{i,j} $ is defined as the nearest multiple of $ \frac{1}{B{g}^{\ell}} $ on the torus, we have $ |\bar{a}{i,j}- $ $ a{i,j}|\leq 1/2B_{q}^{\ell}=\epsilon. $
extraction_issues.reason: 公式中 $B_g$ 被 OCR 误写为 $B_q$，且 $\bar{a}_{i,j}$ 与 $a_{i,j}$ 的下标被拆散，影响公式准确性。

extraction_issues.quote: $$ \left\| \operatorname {E r r} (A \square B) \right\| _ {\infty} \leq (k + 1) \ell N \beta \left\| \operatorname {E r r} (A) \right\| _ {\infty} + \left\| \mu_ {A} \right\| _ {1} (1 + k N) \epsilon + \left\| \mu_ {A} \right\| _ {1} \left\| \operatorname {E r r} (B) \right\| _ {\infty} $$

extraction_issues.quote: $$ \operatorname {V a r} \left(\operatorname {E r r} \left(A \square B\right)\right) \leq (k + 1) \ell N \beta^ {2} \operatorname {V a r} \left(\operatorname {E r r} (A)\right) + (1 + k N) \left\| \mu_ {A} \right\| _ {2} ^ {2} \epsilon^ {2} + \left\| \mu_ {A} \right\| _ {2} ^ {2} \operatorname {V a r} \left(\operatorname {E r r} (\boldsymbol {b})\right) $$
